description: Smaller listed companies earn a premium over larger ones. Disputed since the 1980s; included as a test. Fundamentals are point-in-time: only figures filed on or before each rebalance are used. Falsified if it does not beat the equal-weight benchmark after 10 bps costs.
title: Size · smallest 100 of the Top 1000 by market value (after Banz 1981) · long only
